contract.purpose: Expose real file and image attachments in MAGRA web composer instead of inserting only @-mentions.
contract.scope: Attachment chips, image previews, remove actions, picker behavior, and drag-drop semantics in dashboard chat.

ux-rules.rule-1: Attachments are distinct from @-mentions and render as dedicated chips.
ux-rules.rule-2: Image attachments show preview metadata before provider payload mapping runs in client send path.
ux-rules.rule-3: Drag-drop attaches files by default instead of rewriting draft text into @-mentions.
ux-rules.rule-4: When current model route does not advertise image input, composer shows inline vision-model-required hint for image attachments.
